description: This file defines a custom test execution listener for the SalesManager application, managing EntityManager lifecycle during tests.

classes.name: SalesManagerCoreTestExecutionListener
classes.description: A custom test execution listener that handles setup and cleanup of EntityManager during test executions.

methods.name: beforeTestClass
methods.description: Prepares the test context by autowiring dependencies before any tests in the class run.

methods.name: beforeTestMethod
methods.description: Opens an EntityManager before each test method.

methods.name: afterTestMethod
methods.description: Closes the EntityManager after each test method.
